joint_three.policy: All rows; every selected field must match its human label. Null equals null, missing is not null. Rejection dimensions compare as sets. Internal consistency is separate.

joint_six.policy: All rows; every selected field must match its human label. Null equals null, missing is not null. Rejection dimensions compare as sets. Internal consistency is separate.

rejection_dimensions.failure_handling: Invalid predictions have empty predicted labels; exact-match and sample F1 count them as zero.

rejection_dimensions_on_rejected.failure_handling: Invalid predictions have empty predicted labels; exact-match and sample F1 count them as zero.

rejection_dimensions_valid_only.failure_handling: Invalid predictions have empty predicted labels; exact-match and sample F1 count them as zero.

metric_policy.main_denominator: All frozen benchmark rows; malformed JSON/schema or absent predictions count as incorrect. Structurally valid verdicts are scored even when auxiliary labels are internally inconsistent.
metric_policy.diagnostic_consistency: Cross-field rubric errors are reported separately; raw labels are never corrected. The strict-consistency verdict metric requires both a correct verdict and a successful consistency check.
metric_policy.joint_three: Verdict, timing, and intensity must all equal their human labels on the same row; null intensity remains in the full denominator. No prediction-consistency gate.
metric_policy.joint_six: All six human labels must match; rejection dimensions are compared as sets. Rationale prose and internal consistency are not gates.
metric_policy.intensity_denominator: Only rows with a non-null human intensity label; null cases reported separately.
metric_policy.non_default_subsets: Timing excludes gold Timely; intensity includes only gold Excessive/Insufficient, excluding Appropriate and inapplicable null. Each subset's macro F1 uses its predefined non-default classes; wrong default/null predictions remain confusion columns and count as incorrect.
metric_policy.macro_f1: Unweighted F1 over all predefined labels, including labels with zero support (zero F1).
metric_policy.balanced_accuracy: Unweighted recall over gold labels present in the evaluated subset.

verdict.policy: Always predict the most frequent human class in this scoring population; ties use the declared label order. Analytic reference only, no inference or prompt change.

timing.policy: Always predict the most frequent human class in this scoring population; ties use the declared label order. Analytic reference only, no inference or prompt change.

intensity.policy: Always predict the most frequent human class in this scoring population; ties use the declared label order. Analytic reference only, no inference or prompt change.

intensity_including_null.policy: Always predict the most frequent human class in this scoring population; ties use the declared label order. Analytic reference only, no inference or prompt change.

joint_three.policy: Constant marginal-majority verdict/timing/intensity labels; intensity majority uses all rows, including null. This is an analytic gold-distribution reference, not a fitted or schema-complete model response.

verdict.denominator_policy: Gold and all-row prediction fractions use this metric's full population. Valid-row prediction fractions exclude failed/absent responses only; a structurally valid null remains a prediction.

timing.denominator_policy: Gold and all-row prediction fractions use this metric's full population. Valid-row prediction fractions exclude failed/absent responses only; a structurally valid null remains a prediction.

intensity.denominator_policy: Gold and all-row prediction fractions use this metric's full population. Valid-row prediction fractions exclude failed/absent responses only; a structurally valid null remains a prediction.

intensity_including_null.denominator_policy: Gold and all-row prediction fractions use this metric's full population. Valid-row prediction fractions exclude failed/absent responses only; a structurally valid null remains a prediction.

verdict_confidence_intervals.method: percentile cluster bootstrap; resample complete scenario groups with replacement

performance.accounting: Usage and request counts cover every persisted HTTP attempt; per-request/item latency is neither measured nor recorded.
performance.reasoning_tokens_note: Reasoning tokens are zero if the serving API does not report a separate count.
